Definition: from a derivative of κόλαξ (a fawner); flattery:-- X flattering.
BiblicalUsage: Kolakeia is flattery, fawning words. 1 Thessalonians 2:5 has Paul saying, neither at any time used we flattering words, as ye know, nor a cloke of covetousness, God is witness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul pairs flattery with covetousness on purpose: the flattering word is the cloak the greedy man wears, and God sees under it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
